narr: A mid level trough and a quasi-stationary boundary across Southern New England led to widespread flash flooding in the late hours of the 3rd into the 4th. Most of the flooding was in Rhode Island and Connecticut where cars became stuck in water, and several basements were flooded. In MA a few roads were closed.
ev: In Fall River, Broadway at Ponte Delgada Blvd. was flooded and impassable.
In Attleboro there was significant street flooding at the intersection of Newport Ave and Irving Ave.
In Swansea, there was high water across entire portion of road near the 2000 block of Rt 6.
In Fall River, a section of Country St was flooded and impassable with cars stuck in floodwaters.
Portion of Rt 44 (Winthrop St) is flooded to where Mass DOT was requested.
